cards.audioText: Smoke in the flight deck, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱内出现烟雾，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: First, I will ask another crew member to check the smoke source. At the same time, I would wear the oxygen mask and smoke goggles in case the smoke is toxic. I would follow the applicable SOP and complete the applicable checklist to try to solve the problem. Then I would advise ATC of our situation and request to descend to ventilate the aircraft due to smoke on board. Finally, I would request to land as soon as possible and request fire services and medical assistance upon arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我会让另一名机组成员检查烟雾来源。同时，我们会戴上氧气面罩和防烟护目镜，以防烟雾有毒。我们会遵循标准操作程序（SOP），执行检查单尝试解决问题。随后，会将情况告知管制员，请求下降以给因机上烟雾而通风换气。最后，会请求尽快着陆，并在抵达时要求消防和医疗援助。

cards.audioText: What may cause smoke in the flight deck?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱出现烟雾的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: There are some reasons for smoke in the cockpit. For example, electrical system problems, wire wear-out, dangerous goods leakage, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 驾驶舱出现烟雾有多种原因，比如电气系统故障、导线磨损、危险物品泄漏等等。

cards.audioText: Smoke in the cabin, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱内出现烟雾，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: First, I will ask the cabin crew to check the smoke source. At the same time, I would advise ATC of our situation and request to descend to ventilate the aircraft due to smoke on board. Finally, I would request to land as soon as possible and request fire services and medical assistance upon arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我会让客舱乘务员检查烟雾来源。同时，我们会将情况告知管制员，请求下降以给因机上烟雾而通风换气。最后，会请求尽快着陆，并在抵达时要求消防和医疗援助。

cards.audioText: Have you ever heard any accidents caused by smoke or fire on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾听说过机上因烟雾或火灾引发的事故吗？
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. I have not heard of any. I think smoke or fire is very dangerous for flight safety. Because they may develop very fast, and it will have serious consequences; the aircraft may be out of control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。我没听说过这类事故。我认为烟雾或火灾对飞行安全极为危险，因为它们可能蔓延发展得很快，会产生严重后果，飞机可能会失控。
